queries.result: The official Jabalpur district land-record page identifies the local Bhulekh office and links the MP portal. The MP government service catalog documents land records and map-copy services, including current cadastral maps. The WebGIS2 map app is officially referenced for land parcel maps, but its host timed out from the local shell; this is not evidence the service is down. No vector response or WUP-point lookup was verified.
queries.method: Official district/state pages and bounded anonymous GET to WebGIS2.
